hooks.name: Block ADR file writes
hooks.description: Blocks any write to a file under docs/adr/ before it happens

action.command: $input = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $path = $input.tool_input.path; if ($path -match 'docs[\\/]adr[\\/]') { Write-Error 'Writes to docs/adr/ are blocked. Edit ADR files manually or get explicit approval.'; exit 2 }
